scores.note: The frame is already pushing in at 0 s, the face-off and the bottle read at once, and the cut to the sulking fern at 1.2 s adds a beat; the paper figures themselves still move little in the first half-second.
Standoff, blind watering, the turn (she notices, the reveal), the demonstration (the capful insert, the routine) and the evening payoff are all there; act 4 is no longer one held shot.
Still no specific detail of Juno's own: v2 started at Direction, so the story stage that owns this fix was not re-run.
The pour is now on screen as its own insert, and the voice says 'the Sprigly cap' with the rule, so the product visibly causes the change.
Planted on the sill at 0 s, pulsing behind the fern at 5.4 s, revealed at 7.6 s with the name filling the frame, tagged on the end card with a purchase anchor (250 ml makes 50 L).
Relief carries it; the arms-up surprise at 6.5 s is a bigger gesture than the calm tone, though it reads as comic timing.
The season is now in the voice, the caption and a subline; the evening fern is still fully perky, which lightly implies a result the brief rules out promising.

output.verdict: A directed cut: varied sizes, the pour shown and the name married to the rule fix v1's two biggest gaps; the character is still generic.
fixes: Re-run the story stage to give Juno one specific detail (a named pot, a 'feed day' sticky note) and carry it into two shots.
Frame s9 lower or move the 'spring and summer' subline so it clears her bun.
Add a smaller 'notice' pose to the kit (eyes and a slight lean) for turn beats; arms-up is too big for a calm product.
Keep the payoff fern only slightly perkier than the droopy one (a modest variant), not fully lush.
Make the capful insert's stream thicker so the pour reads at phone size.
output.reason: v2 scores 30/35 against v1's 28: the two rules the director stage owns (the turn shown, the brand map) moved up, and the hook now moves from the first frame. What remains belongs to earlier stages (the character) and to kit gaps (a subtler pose, a modest fern), so the next cut should re-run from Story.
